title: Deca

description.en: A local-first Mac gateway that brings AI agents to Discord, the terminal, and HTTP.
description.zh: 优先在本地运行的 Mac AI 智能体网关，连接 Discord、终端与 HTTP。

subject: A midnight teal rotary desk telephone

source.description: Local-first macOS AI agent gateway with multi-channel support

palette.source: Adopted Deca presentation, 2026-09-07-01/01; background.base in archived settings.json

subject.en: A midnight teal rotary desk telephone
subject.zh: 午夜青色旋转拨号电话

description.en: A complete receiver rests on a broad rotary telephone, with a short coil gathered closely to the body. The familiar physical device represents a local agent gateway and its channels.
description.zh: 完整听筒落在宽阔转盘电话上，短卷线紧靠机身；熟悉的实体设备呼应本地 Agent 网关及多种通信通道。

description.en: Deep teal Bakelite, an ivory rotary dial and fine brass seams make a calm premium object. The cable-loop background is removed while real dark dial recesses stay intact.
description.zh: 深青蓝胶木、象牙色转盘与黄铜细接缝构成沉稳实物。线圈环内去除背景，转盘真实暗部凹孔保留。

description.en: Three rounded switchboard routing paths with discrete paired terminals in cool blue-gray paper. The field, grain and contact shadow are independent of transparent app marks.
description.zh: 蓝灰纸面上的三条圆润总机接线与成对终端。 底色、颗粒与接触阴影均独立于透明应用标记。

palette.source: Adopted Deca presentation, 2026-09-07-01/01; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px, the receiver silhouette and ivory rotary dial remain clear. At 32/24/16 px, the compact silhouette and dominant colors carry recognition; fine material detail, printed marks and background lines naturally merge.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 能辨认听筒剪影与象牙色转盘；32/24/16 px 以紧凑轮廓和主色维持识别，精细材质、印记与背景线条自然合并。

goal.en: Use a locally hosted personal agent through Discord, a terminal, or HTTP to work with files, commands, remembered context, and scheduled tasks.
goal.zh: 通过 Discord、终端或 HTTP 使用本机运行的个人 Agent，处理文件、命令、已有记忆和定时任务。

role.zh: 本地 Agent 与工作区
会话、配置与上下文文件

description.en: Three rounded routing paths connect paired terminals, recalling a telephone switchboard.
description.zh: 三条圆转线路连接成对端点，呼应旋转电话背后的交换台。

alt.en: A midnight teal rotary desk telephone on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 午夜青色旋转拨号电话，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.en: A familiar line to your agents.
caption.zh: 用熟悉的方式，接通智能体。

description.zh: 午夜青色旋转拨号电话。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥63px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 63px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
